blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu.

On arrival, you will be met and taken straight to the Brazilian side of the falls.

Iguaçu lies near the borders of Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay and comprises around 275 major cascades.

Its name means “big water” in the Tupi-Guarani language.

The falls are within a national park rich in flora and fauna. Their present landscape is linked to ancient volcanic processes and shifts in the rock formations. As you approach the main cascades, the river's calm flow changes abruptly, plunging into the canyon.

The main section is the Devil's Throat, where the water drops about 72 m.

Viewing platforms offer a panorama of the falls and bring you close enough to feel the thick spray in the air.

This is a private tour with an English-speaking guide.
